text:
Awesome, glad to hear it's all set up! 

When you're ready to pull the clean, deduped list into a final tab without doing manual copy-pasting, you can drop a single `FILTER` formula into cell A2 of a new `Final` sheet to automatically grab only the good rows (e.g., pulling your cleaned columns where column P is `"OK"` and column O is blank).

If you hit any snags while working through your `REVIEW` rows or need help setting up a summary tab, just let me know!
